notes.title: Patch 19.1
Patch 19 – RELEASE BUILD UPDATE
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/3297c271f6f1eb1a939f2c252d6905f1596ef27b.png[/img]

OHMYGOD! Skyfront uploaded its RELEASE BUILD! But wait, why does it look like we're still in EA? Well, Steam has it's rules and we want to abide by them, but we also want to give you our amazing game at a really good price during the holiday season... Long story short, the EA marker is a technicality and what you have here, ladies and gentlemen, is the Release Build of Skyfront VR! ːsteamhappyː The official transition from EA to Full Release will take place after the holiday season. 

[b][h1]So let's see what's new! [/h1][/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/bcc50b96700eabed76f4a3bd6577ed6345350882.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/b92b82bb0e47d4822eea0d5f151132b5dd827b4f.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/022b7c8542eb42234d206b5066139b34d9ca2c6f.jpg[/img]

Say hello to [b]Genesis[/b] – our new space inspired arena! It's dark, it's mysterious and it's packed with fun! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/b2b458ece8bdb2bc0259aedef0b1d3acb084a501.jpg[/img]

The game now features a [b]progression[/b] system that awards players XP as they gain more experience. Every time you level up, you unlock cosmetic items. 

This brings us to – [b]customisation[/b]! You can choose between tons of unlockable skins, visors and trails to create your perfect VR you! Gain XP to unlock more items. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/004120e721e4be025f496c9f4c03293d022ba520.jpg[/img]

To thank everybody that backed us during our time in EA, we have created a special [b]Founder's Pack[/b]. The Epic skin, two Epic visors and an Epic trail in the pack will ONLY be available to those that purchased Skyfront before 20 December 2018. Thank you, all! 

Minor fixes in the patch:
[list]
[*] The Pineapple has been nerfed from 40 to 20 damage per pellet. 
[*] If nobody votes during map vote, the game will continue on the same arena. 
[*] The player outline is now thinner and we scrapped it altogether in Single DM. 
[*] Visual fixes to the Egypt and Convent arenas. 
[*] A plethora of visual fixes in menus and the HUD. 
[/list]

And to top it off, Skyfront is now also available on the [b]Oculus store[/b]! With crossplatform gameplay, there will be tons more opponents to shoot at and immensely more fun to be had!

notes.title: Patch 18 – New Convent Map, Domination Mode and Much More!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/98ffc90e2d96799f0a5ff8f2730ee209f529dfa5.png[/img]

Thank you guys for your patience!
Here it finally is, our map number three – [b]the Convent[/b]!

The Convent is inspired by medieval architecture and was once the home of scribes and monks. The huge statues within the cathedral stand guard over this vast monument. On the outskirts of the Convent, you'll find cosy little huts and secret towers.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/98a99dc659deacbc7feb5762b9fd2c1f231e142e.jpg[/img]

Along with the third map, we've added a [b]map vote[/b]. The prompt appears after every three games. The next game will take place on the map that won the majority vote. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/794931b56cff1b9ad6af71f76e93a2b072809aa1.png[/img]

The second huge addition in this patch is a [b]third game mode – Domination[/b]. Battle the opposing team to gain and keep control of the three domination points on the map. The first team to get 250 points wins. 

We've also added a new [b]custom on-screen keyboard[/b] to fix several usability issues with the native Steam VR keyboard.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/bafe9fcb7416aaa52ca3c10bfc7dfaef3da9b582.jpg[/img]

The patch brings a [b]new health bar[/b]. The design of the health bar makes it easier to read from a distance. 

The [b]bots[/b] have been nerfed and now shoot less often and miss more. We're hoping we've hit a good balance now but please do let us know if the bots still feel a bit OP. 

Finally, a [b]server migration notification[/b] was added to inform the players of a server migration. 

Coming up next – Steam Workshop!

notes.title: Patch 17 – GIANT UPDATE
notes.content:
Buckle up, cause we're back with a giant patch of goodies for you! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/81d889af165935678cf940870cbfc771d3c327af.png[/img]

The biggest change you'll notice the second you launch Skyfront is our new UI! We've given everything from the main menu to the in-game menus a proper face-lift! The new UI is more sleek, improves UX and oozes of esports polish! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/05fc8296ec92a67941a43d323ea2f3d757c15481.jpg[/img]

We've also added a HUD that displays the player's HP, game time and score according to the game mode. You can customise the HUD as well as the hand display – which has also been revamped – from the Options menu.
Now you can also choose, which hand you want the display to appear on. Heck, you can even have it on both hands! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/6507ae77c5e32c8a5f881698bcb70af54c5c4a31.jpg[/img]

This patch also brings an addition to the special abilities available to you in Skyfront. Say hello to Jammer! The new ability jams the special abilities of all of your opponents in a 50 m radius for 6 seconds. Yes, we mean all special abilities, even a shockwave that's already heading your way! Look out Shield abusers! 

Skyfront now also has music! We worked with composed Arian Levin to add some atmosphere to the menu and game end and beginning sequences. We're very proud of how it turned out! 

Some minor updates include optimising the rocket and grenade explosions, which should help with the visual lag some players experienced when a lot of explosions went off at once. 

The Shield effect has been updated and polished. 

Adaptive weapon switch mapping is now optional and is set to disabled in the Options menu by default. 

And to conclude this patch, we fixed a bug on the Egypt level that caused a number of effects, e.g. the fire and explosions to become transparent at times due to the skybox shaders.

notes.title: Patch 16
notes.content:
Today's patch 16 includes a number of cool updates that make your experience in Skyfront a ton sleeker and more streamlined!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/e2dec62cea141654411b6ed2d92d8069576eb55f.png[/img]

Team Deathmatch mode was long overdue for some TLC.
The Team Deatchmatch game mode now allows players to select their team. When you join Team Deathmatch, you will be asked, which team you want to join. As long as the match hasn't started, you have two additional chances to switch teams. Mid-match team changes will not be possible. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/903aa5fc8787a35206c43f236ca620ca5d45e458.png[/img]

This patch brings a redesigned death screen, which now tells you both the name of your killer, as well as the weapon that killed you. In addition, the death screen will display your current killstreak, should you have gone on one. 

Another major update concerns the weapon switch. When you have one weapon equipped, you can click on either side of the scrollwheel to bring up the other weapon. We hope the carousel weapon switch will make it easier and quicker to switch weapons mid-game. 

To tweak the meta, we buffed the Locust minigun. A single bullet now does 30 HP damage, instead of the former 20. In addition, the bullet spread when you have the gun equipped with both hands has now been reduced to 0. 

To top it off, the Gamehub match list now displays active match hosts instead of the original match creators. 

And one bug fix as well: 
- Removed a bug that caused the volume to go all the way down whenever a player changed the volume settings in-game.

notes.title: Major Updates in Patch 14
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/6e18f018fab4b6660eb7f58d886ad2fa2f250186.jpg[/img]

[h1]KABOOM! POW! CRACK![/h1]
Yes, we’re finally introducing our grenade launcher, Pineapple! This weapon is a heck of a lot of fun and shoots three grenades with 60 pellets each with a reload time of just 1.5 seconds! The grenades have a range of 500 metres and travel at a speed of 60 m/s. The damage radius of each grenade is 15 m with a splash damage of 20 to 100 hp and an additional 40 hp damage per pellet hit. Talk about versatile, right?! 

Some additional features include the grenades bouncing off walls and a distance indicator that turns green when an opponent is within the grenade’s damage radius. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/618a6780eb6274fae11a075d73bd880c25d72f95.png[/img]

The second big update in this patch is the [b]tutorial[/b] that will take the player through basic game functions, e.g. how to use the thrusters, how to fly, use the grapple and select and use weapons. We haven’t included some of the more complicated features – like how to use two-handed weapons more efficiently – into the tutorial, but we’re working to add these into the game very soon. 

By adding the tutorial, we also cleaned up the Main Menu hierarchy to make the Tutorial and Loadouts section more visible. 

Of course, this patch also includes quite a few [b]bug fixes[/b]. We fixed:
[list]
[*]A bug that allowed players to place the Locust minigun inside structures and essentially shoot through walls;
[*]A bug that displayed opponents as holding two weapons even when they were actually using one two-handed weapon; 
[*]A bug with particles from the rocket launcher’s explosions that gave the particles’ infinite lifetime thus causing vfx build-up and visual lag;
[*]Several sound vfx bugs; 
[*]And some other tiny, barely noticeable bugs. ːsteamhappyː
[/list]

notes.content:
[h1]Buckle up, because this hunk is going to make you weak in the knees![/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/00e235e194e46968a0a39095e6393b73bb9f0df6.jpg[/img]

For [b]Valentine's Day[/b], we are channelling our romantic side with a bunch of hearts and pink and... well, you get the drift. Enjoy our very own Mr Charming from February 14th until the 18th! 

[h1]But now, drum roll please![/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/7e3f750618e29dd09962f02584bfe01e1f8eb806.png[/img]

Skyfront has [b]private matches[/b]! Whooo!! Yeah! The crowd goes wild! 
This new functions allows any player to create a password protected match. The match will be visible in Game Hub with a lock icon. To make it easier to find a particular match, the Game Hub listing now also displays the name of the match host. Whether you manage an arcade, just want to play against your friends without meddling veteran players killing you before you even get your bearings after a spawn, or are organising a tournament style event in Skyfront, this new addition will definitely come in handy!

This patch is also heavily concentrated on [b]fine-tuning our weapons[/b]. 

It's become pretty apparent that the current meta heavily favoured the shotgun-sniper combo. To liven things up a bit and make other weapons more viable alternatives, we've made the following damage changes:
[list]
[*]Revolver 90 -> 100 (headshot 200)
[*]Rifle 30 -> 40
[/list]

And to scale back the use of the Sniper Rifle as a stand-in for the Revolver, the Sniper Rifle will now only do 200 damage in double-handed mode. One-handed damage is 100.

We've also adjusted the reload times of the weapons as follows:
[list]
[*]Automatic Rifle 1.5s -> 1s
[*]Rocket Launcher 2.5s -> 2s
[*]Revolver 1.5 remains the same
[*]Sniper 3s -> 2s
[*]Shotgun 2s -> 1.5s
[/list]

The final weapon related update in this patch concerns the [b]Grappling Hook[/b]. We know how much some of you love to spiderman around the arena, but... it kind of makes you guys hard to target. So we've reduced the distance of the Grappling Hook by 50% to limit the mobility and maximum speed the grapple currently provides. 

And as a fun addition, the [b]Match End Menu[/b] now includes some dandy [b]animations[/b].

notes.title: Stats + Killstreak & Multikill
notes.content:
Hold on to your hats because the stats are here! 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/530f50036945731af86c3657e2e25a6b6acfb388.png[/img]

The new feature allows you to keep track of your kills, k/d ratio, best killstreak (more about these below) and a ton of other knick-knacks; it also includes comparisons to the current average scores, match bests and personal bests. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/7bc4200f51a3c0e9fc0b5a5f505346fe15d88989.png[/img]

The My Stats view includes games played, wins, avg position, best kills, best damage, favourite weapon, favourite special ability and much more! At the moment, the stats are only displayed for games played in Single Deathmatch, but you can expect a BIGGER and BETTER update to the stats shortly, including game mode and weapon specific indicators. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/5617a08bc0d5881466cb588b202fcf473cd5fb25.png[/img]

Another cool addition arriving in this patch are Killstreaks and Multikills. Since it turns out that these two notions are not at all as clearcut as we thought, let's get things straight – a killstreak is the number of kills you achieve without dying, or before the end of the match, while a multikill is a number of kills in quick succession. The killstreak notification will be displayed after every fifth kill and the multikill count keeps ticking as long as you manage to kill an opponent within ten seconds of your previous kill. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/034372bb9948e23621180d58a392b33553435efb.png[/img]

We improved the grappling hook by adding a crosshair that indicates the exact place of contact. A green crosshair means that the target is in range and a red one that the target is out of range. Once the hook connects, the boost will be multiplied by four, which allows you to change direction as the hook retracts and improve your navigation accuracy. 

Also, the Game Hub match list now refreshes automatically and shows the active match list in real-time.

And here are the bugs squashed in this patch:
- The revolver now properly fires during the recoil animation;
- Fixed the flipped display bug that occured on the left hand sniper rifle;
- No more problems with Autoheal data not reaching the server.

notes.title: Skyfront Winter Onslaught – Rules
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/646deed534bb97455b34c8960346ab970717a244.jpg[/img]

[h1]Overview[/h1]
Skyfront Winter Onslaught in partnership with ASL is our first community competition since Early Access launch! We’ve designed the event as a newcomer-friendly competition where players compete for the highest number of kills in a single Single Deathmatch game – play time is not limited and all weapons and special abilities are allowed! 

[h1]Date and Time[/h1]
The event will take place in two rounds:
Round one – from 22 December 8 PM UTC until 28 December 3 AM UTC
Round two – from 29 December 8 PM UTC until 4 January 3 AM UTC 

[h1]Important Notes[/h1]
High scores from arcades will not be included in this event. Tournament-style events for arcades are definitely in store for the future so don’t fret it – your time will come! We’d still love for you to join in the fun and root for our community!
Speaking of community, we want to allow newcomers a chance at victory – and so we are also omitting our Skyfront veterans (or seasoned players) from the event. We will talk to these individuals privately, so if we haven’t spoken to you, you are not one of them! 
While our veterans and arcades are omitted, they can still join the event, but their kills will not be counted towards anything – so if you think you are being beaten at any point, you may still be in first place! 
The entire event will also be moderated to ensure no one is cheating or breaking any rules. 

[h1]Prizes[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/278df480f6262316a2044721e6f066fcf654993c.jpg[/img]
First place – $ 50 Steam gift card + DM002 RC Drone with Camera & Goggles
Second place – $ 25 Steam gift card
Third place – $ 10 Steam gift card


[h1]Rules[/h1]
1. Players will compete for the highest kill count in a Single Deathmatch game.
2. Your death count will not affect your chance of winning – we are only looking at your kill count.
3. The kill count will be registered at the end of the game or when the player exits the game.
4. All weapons and special abilities are allowed. Use what you think will get you the victory!
5. Players are forbidden from teaming up and assisting each other, using bugs/glitches, and intentionally farming AFK players with the intention of raising their kill count.
6. Abusive behaviour will not be tolerated in-game, especially in VOIP – this is a community event, keep it friendly!
7. The high scores will be counted for games with a minimum of three players at the start of the game. NOTE! If the game starts with three players and two players leave before the end of the game, the kill count of the last remaining player will be locked the moment the second to last player leaves the game.
8. The winners are the players with the top three highest number of kills at the end of a competition round, i.e. the top three at the end of round one on December 28th and the top three at the end of round two on January 4th. 
9. Veterans and arcade accounts are excluded from the competition (see Important Notes above).
10. Prizes will be awarded at the end of both rounds of the competition (for round times see Date and Time above).

notes.title: A Glimpse at What’s to Come
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/95c5c7ffb6480088dcb7e411b1f426235bdbe355.jpg[/img]

Phew, the holiday season, amiright?! We’ve been busy as hell trying to cram as many bug fixes and cool little additions into Skyfront as we can before 2017 draws to a close. 

Our biggest announcement for the holiday season is the Skyfront Winter Onslaught competition in partnership with Aerial Sports League (ASL)! We are beyond excited and humbled to be working with such a huge name in aerial sports. Winter Onslaught will be our first step towards a crossover competition combining VR and live-action drone combat.

Winter Onslaught will take place in two rounds from December 22nd until January 4th and allows you to win some killer prizes, including Steam Gift Cards and a freaking drone! Players will be competing for the highest kill count in a single Deathmatch game. In both rounds, the victorious player will receive a $50 Steam Gift Card and a drone kit from ASL, the second and third place holders will receive a $25 and $10 Steam Gift Card respectively. Read more about the event on our Discord channel at https://discord.gg/V6tYC2t and stay up to date by following us on social media (links below).
 
Oh, and to sprinkle a little holiday spirit into the mix, we’re throwing in this adorably dorky Christmas skin because… well, mostly, why not? But on the practical side, this skin is the first glimpse into the future of character customisation in Skyfront.

We have also added an in-game headshot notification to really celebrate how good of a shot you are! Yes, the artwork is just temporary and will be replaced with some fancier graphics very soon. 

To make loadout changes more seamless, we removed the ‘Apply’ button, meaning that loadout changes are now saved automatically. 

Changes to look out for in the upcoming months – user statistics. 

And now to the nitty-gritty… The things we fixed in this update:
– Sniper gun’s zoom would reset to 0 when placed inside an object; 
– All displayed scores would reset for a player if he/she left and then rejoined a match;
– Weapon prompt displayed newly selected weapons before the player had actually respawned;
– Missing collision boxes on several of the objects on the Egypt level, incl. the gloomy Anubis statue, have been replaced.

https://twitter.com/SkyfrontVR
https://www.instagram.com/skyfrontvr/

NB! Make sure you have the latest version of the game installed. If you are not sure, restarting Steam client usually does the trick.

notes.title: December update vol 1
notes.content:
Hey, a semi-quick update! 

We’ve been plowing on with new developments for Skyfront VR. Today, as promised, we're adding some features to make it easier to find and create matches.

- GAME HUB. You can now access match list straight from the Main Menu by selecting Play>Game Hub.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/3bb1cb962a798a11fcbc1a2dfeeb74973997ad59.jpg[/img]

- WEAPON PROMPT. We added a holographic prompt to show you the weapons and key bindings are currently active. NOTE: You can disable this feature in the options menu.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/e759e6720bceca5f0bc26588422eb3c7f78e2621.jpg[/img]

- Revolver NERF! Due to community feedback we nerfed revolver damage from 100HP to 90HP. That means you can no longer one-shot your unfortunate opponents. Double headshot should still do the trick though!

Bug fixes:

- Reaching into a wall with the controller would allow you to shoot through it, leading to some very unfair kills with the sniper rifle. No longer. Fixed!
- Sometimes changes in loadouts wouldn’t save - Fixed!
- In case of leaving the match and going back to the Main Menu, the pointer would sometimes disappear - Fixed!
- Sometimes players weren’t able to re-join a match after the host migration - Fixed!
- Automatic Rifle reload animation issues after a weapon swap during reload animation - Fixed!
- Changed Automatic Rifle recoil to constant instead of cumulative animation.
- Fixed “Killed by…” tag visibility issue. It will now always face you as you move around.
- A player starting a match in Egypt map would be briefly positioned inside the pyramid floor - Fixed!


Next up, a personal User Profile with detailed gameplay statistics (wins, kills, deaths, k/d ratio etc), updates to the game menu and a special Christmas surprise.
We will also be announcing a COMMUNITY EVENT, the first on many, which will make better use of our current leaderboard and give players an equal chance to come up on top. Also, some sweet rewards!
In the meantime, get back to us on Discord, Facebook and Steam Community and let us know your thoughts on updates as well as what cool features we should be working on next!

notes.title: November update
notes.content:
Hey guys,

We've been busy as hell and are excited to release our first Early Access update.

- Added recoil to all weapons! For some it's purely cosmetical, adding to the realness of using a weapon. For Revolver, Shotgun and Sniper Rifle it also works as a nerf. Each shot is followed by a vertical offset, which makes it harder to score several hits in quick succession, a method that more experienced players were quick to exploit.
- Shotgun has been buffed. Amount of bullets per shot is up from 10 to 16, damage per bullet reduced from 30 to 20 HP, reload time reduced from 2 secs to 1,5 secs.
- Added support for WINDOWS MIXED REALITY headset! Remapped the controls to the joystick so everything should work same as on Oculus.
- Lot's of updates to the Egypt map, including graphical optimizations and replacing missing collision boxes.
- Team Deathmatch max size is now 5v5, instead of 3v3.
- Bots now react to Stealth and X-ray special abilities, ie Stealth makes the player invisible to bots and X-ray reveals the location of all bots on the map. 

We also fixed several bugs:
- A bug where a shotgun trails remained in the air when shot close to a shield or a map dome.
- A bug where revolver became stuck after rapid firing and would only work again after a respawn.
- A bug with the game stats window which in some cases continued to show results from a previous match.
- some other minor fixes to the menu and maps.

Our next update will focus on accessibility, making it easier to learn the controls and finding and creating matches. We also have some bigger updates in store. In the meantime, check out the new features and let us know what you think on Discord, Facebook and Steam Community. We'll be listening and playing with you!

notes.content:

So thank you for jumping on board and have fun!

Team Skyfront
